messages.subject: Re: ggplot2 (logistic regression)
parts:
Give geom_smooth a shot at http://docs.ggplot2.org/current/geom_smooth.html . 

Follow the examples to either keep or nix the confidence intervals. Read the fine print - depending on your sample size, the function will automatically use a different algorithm to provide a smoothed line.

Dear Ben and Umi,

thank you so much. 
You are rigth! I used now geom_smooth instead geom_ribbon and the graphic is much better.
My original sintaxe was: 

ggplot (newdata3, aes(x= Age, y= PredictedProb)) + geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = LL, ymax = UL, fill = RASS), alpha = 0.2) + geom_line(aes(colour = RASS), size=0.5)


Many thanks again!


Dimitri
